subject.why: The blue diamond on a crimson cushion with gold tassels is clearly recognisable and includes all requested elements.

category.why: The object floats in the air with a slight tilt against a single-colour radiating ray pattern background, adhering to Category 1 rules.

clean.why: No text, UI, borders, watermarks, or characters are present.

framing.why: The subject is centrally framed with ample margins on all sides and a readable, chunky silhouette.

colour.why: The warm orange background provides great contrast to the vibrant blue diamond and deep red cushion.

detail.why: The facets are clean and chunky without distracting micro-textures, and the star twinkle acts as a charming focal point.

style.why: The 3D rendering matches the references with smooth volumes, soft highlights, satin sheen, and no outlines.

bg_colour.why: background is orange (99% of the background); planned orange
